user.title: Describe the house
user.description: Pick one temperature sensor per room (dedicated wall sensors work best), an outdoor temperature source, and the thermostat. A gas meter, if the furnace burns gas, measures the heat it delivers. Solar power is used as a proxy for sunlight; fan and ventilation are optional on/off signals such as an HRV status. History already in the recorder is used for training straight away.

data.rooms: Room temperature sensors (several per room are fine)
data.weather_forecast: Weather forecast (if the outdoor source is not a weather entity)
data.group_by_area: Treat sensors in the same area as one room

data_description.group_by_area: Sensors in one area are calibrated against each other (offset, sun exposure, noise) and blended into one room temperature.
data_description.gas_meter: Optional. Gas burned measures the heat the furnace actually delivers (better than on/off time for two-stage or modulating furnaces). Use a cumulative meter reading.
data_description.gas_unit: Override when the meter reports the wrong unit, e.g. a raw ft³ counter labelled CCF.

error.no_rooms: Select at least one room sensor.
error.outdoor_is_room: The outdoor source cannot also be a room.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: The planner runs in shadow mode: it recommends heating/cooling but never changes the thermostat. Leave the comfort target empty to follow the thermostat's own setpoint.

data_description.energy_weight: How much an hour of full heating costs, relative to 1 K of discomfort for an hour. Higher saves energy, lower favours comfort.
data_description.spread_weight: How much to penalise rooms drifting apart from each other.
data_description.gas_price: Optional. Used to show the cost of the planned gas, in your Home Assistant currency.

export_dataset.name: Export training data
export_dataset.description: Write the collected training set and fitted model to thermal_mpc_dataset.yaml in the config folder, for offline analysis. Overwrites the previous export.
